explication: DPaint.js is a browser-based pixel-art and animation editor centered on a document-editing workflow: users interact through the editor and tools, modify a layered image and palette, and export to image or Amiga formats. Its major branches include color reduction and dithering, frame-based animation, undo/redo, and Amiga-specific file and emulator support. The graph uses README claims for documented capabilities and the supplied source index or excerpts for implementation links; unsampled modules are not assumed to have inspected call paths.
